crossRefs.note: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram…
The king said to Araunah, “No; but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings…
In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord…
Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…

people.name: Ephron
people.line: A Hittite who sold a burial site to Abraham.

translations.web: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”
translations.bsb: and said to Ephron in their presence, “If you will please listen to me, I will pay you the price of the field. Accept it from me, so that I may bury my dead there.”
translations.kjv: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead
translations.asv: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt, I pray thee, hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
